thread:
maria_g: kick-off — quick sync on the web copy pass for hosted / dedicated / private. goal: one hero set + 2 variants per mode, plus launch posts and webinar hook. who can own the benchmark narrative?

alex_reeves: I can write the benchmark lead paragraph (latency vs cost narrative). want a tight stat: 95th p90 latency and tokens/$ example.

sam_k: for webinar hook, let's lean into 'real customers reduced serving costs by X' — need a case study ask. liz_h can chase ops?

liz_h: on it. i'll ping cs/eng for a short blurb. also — inbound routing: we should gate enterprise demo leads differently from self-serve leads. suggest form fields: company size + compliance needs.

maria_g: agreed. inbound routing rule draft: if company_size > 500 or compliance == "yes" -> route to AE queue; else -> SDR sequence. also webhook to HubSpot for immediate lead enrichment.

sam_k: love that. can we add a marketing pixel and a single-click 'request enterprise review' CTA on Private page? less friction but clear path.

alex_reeves: benchmark narrative: i'll draft something like: "Across representative workloads, Redwood's serving profile cut per-token cost by 3x while holding p95 latency under 150ms vs baseline." will include a small chart callout.

liz_h: for the hero variants: Hosted -> "Start generating in minutes, pay-as-you-go"; Dedicated -> "Reserved capacity, predictable throughput"; Private -> "VPC & on-prem for regulated workloads". keep subheadings 6-8 words max.

maria_g: nice. let's create A/B lines: Variant A = benefit-first (cost/latency), Variant B = trust-first (SLA/security). we'll run both in paid/social and measure CTR -> demo form.

sarah_ops: webinar-bot: created event stub for "Serving at Scale: Cost & Latency Tradeoffs" on May 7, 2026 at 10am PT. link: https://events.redwood.ai/serve-scale. :calendar:

webinar-bot: Reminder: add partner co-host by EOD Fri if we want joint promotion.

sam_k: promotion plan: 3 launch posts (teaser, benchmark highlight, registration CTA), one technical deep-dive blog, 2 short product tweets/day week of. assets needed: 1 hero gif, benchmark chart PNG, 30s promo clip.

maria_g: timeline check: copy freeze Wed, creative freeze Thu, announcement Mon. can everyone confirm availability for copy review Tue?

alex_reeves: confirm for Tue morning. i'll push benchmark draft by Mon night.

liz_h: i'll have CS blurbs by Mon afternoon.

sam_k: promo assets on track with design. sharing creative brief in #marketing-assets now.

maria_g: inbound routing finalization: i'll write exact HubSpot field mapping and req body. snippet for devs: 

```
POST /hooks/leads
{
  "email": "...",
  "company_size": "...",
  "compliance": "yes|no",
  "mode_interest": "hosted|dedicated|private"
}
```

maria_g: ok — last ask: keep hero language consistent with webinar headline. draft headline options in doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch-hero-drafts

sam_k: small experiment idea: show Hosted hero with dynamic CTA for users from cloud providers (detect via IP) -> demo vs signup split. low lift.

maria_g: perfect. thanks team — i'll consolidate notes and drop copy tasks in Asana. :thumbsup:
